---
title: "Type checking"
---

We use [ty](https://docs.astral.sh/ty/) for static type checking.
ty is configured in the `[tool.ty]` section of `pyproject.toml`.

## Running ty

To check for type errors, run:

```sh
pixi run typecheck
```

The same task is run by the `typecheck` pre-commit hook.

## Rule overrides

Rule-specific, per-file exceptions are configured with `[[tool.ty.overrides]]`
entries. Default rules remain enabled everywhere else. Prefer fixing typing
issues, and remove files or rules from these overrides when they are no longer
needed. Do not add global rule suppressions.

### Suppressing individual errors

For specific lines where the type checker is wrong, use a targeted ignore comment:

```python
x = some_expression  # ty: ignore[error-code]
```

For lines that would exceed 120 characters with the comment appended, place the comment on the line above:

```python
# ty: ignore[error-code]
x = some_very_long_expression_that_would_be_too_long_with_an_inline_comment
```
